jobs.title: Gimbal Design Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented Gimbal Hardware Engineer with strong expertise in electromechanical integration, hardware design, and ruggedized system development. The ideal candidate will focus on the physical and electrical hardware aspects of gimbal systems, ensuring reliability in harsh environmental conditions. This role is suited for a hands-on hardware specialist who excels in connectors, harnessing, sealing, thermal management, and system-level integration of gimbal subsystems. Responsibilities Hardware Design & Integration Design and develop robust hardware architecture for 2-axis/3-axis gimbal systems. Integrate motors, sensors, cameras, PCBs, and wiring subsystems into compact and reliable assemblies. Ensure proper mechanical-electrical interfacing, grounding, and shielding practices. Connectors, Harness & Wiring Select and validate connectors (circular, micro-D, board-to-board, rugged connectors) based on application requirements. Design and develop wiring harnesses, including routing, strain relief, and serviceability. Ensure compliance with communication protocol harness standards for: UART, ; Ethernet / IP-based systems; Video signal transmission (HDMI, LVDS, MIPI, etc.). Perform signal integrity and EMI/EMC considerations in harness design. Environmental Protection & Sealing Design systems to meet IP ratings (IP65/IP67/IP68) for dust and water resistance. Select and implement gaskets, O-rings, sealing compounds, and potting materials. Ensure proper waterproofing and environmental sealing across enclosures, connectors, and cable interfaces. Collaborate on shock, vibration, and environmental robustness requirements. Thermal Management Analyze and implement thermal solutions including: 1) Heatsinks. 2) Thermal pads and interface materials. 3) Passive cooling strategies. Ensure optimal heat dissipation for motors, electronics, and embedded systems. Motor & Hardware Component Selection Select appropriate gimbal motors (BLDC / torque motors) based on mechanical and electrical constraints. Evaluate hardware components such as fasteners, brackets, housings, and mounting interfaces. Understand mechanical load paths and ensure structural integrity. Testing & Validation Conduct hardware validation tests, including: 1) Waterproofing / IP tests 2) Vibration and shock testing 3) Thermal performance validation. Troubleshoot hardware-related issues across connectors, wiring, and packaging. Support field testing and failure analysis. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical / Mechatronics / Electrical / Electronics Engineering or related field. 3+ years of hands-on experience in hardware design for rugged electromechanical systems. Strong understanding of: Connectors and harness design IP ratings and sealing techniques Hardware integration in compact systems Proficiency in CAD tools and mechanical design fundamentals. Ability to interpret technical datasheets and standards. Preferred Skills Experience in UAV payloads, gimbals, or defense/aerospace hardware systems. Knowledge of EMI/EMC design considerations. Familiarity with industrial/military connector standards (MIL-spec). Experience with thermal simulation tools. Exposure to manufacturing processes and vendor coordination. 3-8 Yrs Electronics, Embedded systems, CAD, Architecture, Electronics engineering, Thermal, Simulation, Tools

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary We're hiring a Data Engineer to own our data platform end to end: the pipelines that move data from MongoDB into ClickHouse, the accuracy of every number our customers see, and the performance and cost of ClickHouse itself. You'll work on our live production stack and use AI-assisted development (Claude Code) as part of your everyday workflow. You'll be the first responder when something in your area breaks, so you'll care about root causes, not restarts. Responsibilities 1. Data pipelines Run and improve the event flow from MongoDB through Kinesis, SQS and Lambda consumers, plus ClickPipes, into ClickHouse. Keep consumers healthy: retries, batch item failures, dedup, dead-letter queues, and Mongo and Redis connection limits. Fix failures quickly and find the root cause. A restart doesn't count as a fix. Keep dev, staging and prod schemas in sync, and handle DDL and schema initialisation safely. 2. Data accuracy and reconciliation Own reconciliation between MongoDB (source) and ClickHouse (reports) for orders, feedbacks, loyalty points, credits and comm reports. Investigate customer-reported mismatches (points balances, sales totals, undelivered counts, segment counts) and close each one with a root cause. Build checks that catch drift before customers do: daily row counts, sums and key metrics compared per brand. Get timezone, order_type and status handling right everywhere a metric is computed. 3. Moving to incremental processing Replace full recompute on every event with incremental updates, using ClickHouse materialized views and AggregatingMergeTree instead of repeated MongoDB aggregations. Ship migrations in small, switchable steps, each verified against the old path before cut-over. Retire legacy pipeline paths (Kinesis Lambda ClickHouse) once the replacements are proven correct. 4. ClickHouse optimisation Own schema design: ORDER BY, partition keys, granularity and engine choice, following ClickHouse best practices. Tune the slowest and most expensive queries weekly using system.query_log, and keep the ClickHouse Cloud bill within target. Prevent merge pressure: no forced whole-partition merges, sensible insert batching, healthy part counts. Make sure dashboard and export endpoints meet their latency targets. On-call: Each of these four areas carries its own on-call responsibility. When it breaks, you're the first responder. Must have Strong ClickHouse and analytical SQL (CTEs, window functions, argMax, joins) Production experience running SQS or Kinesis pipelines in Node.js Solid MongoDB experience (aggregations, indexes, change data) Hands-on use of Claude Code or a similar AI coding tool, with the discipline to verify AI output through tests and real data before shipping Nice to have CDC tools such as PeerDB or Debezium EMR Serverless or Spark Python for data checks Experience moving batch recompute to incremental processing Our stack AI-assisted development: Claude Code Pipelines: AWS SQS, Kinesis Data Streams, Lambda, Step Functions Analytics database: ClickHouse Cloud, ClickPipes (CDC) Source database: MongoDB (Mongoose) Compute and deploy: AWS ECS Fargate, Serverless Framework, EventBridge Scheduler, S3, SSM Caching and queues: Redis, Bull Language: Node.js (JavaScript) Observability: Datadog, AWS CloudWatch What success looks like Customer-reported data mismatches are rare, and when they happen they're closed with a root cause. Drift is caught by your checks before customers notice. Metrics run on incremental paths, and the old pipelines are retired. Dashboards and exports hit their latency targets, and the ClickHouse bill stays on target. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. jobs.title: Plc Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Job Purpose To carry out installation verification, configuration, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of Smart electrical components, including energy meters, circuit breakers, communication gateways, and associated SCADA/BMS systems. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Smart Components Commissioning Installation verification, configuration, testing, and commissioning of Schneider Electric smart components. Commission energy meters such as PM5000, PM8000, and other supported PowerLogic meter series. Configure Schneider Electric ACBs, MCCBs, Micrologic trip units, and associated communication interfaces. Verify metering parameters, breaker status, trip indications, alarms, and electrical measurements. Verify CT/PT ratios, Modbus addresses, baud rates, parity, and communication settings. B. Communication and Networking Configure and troubleshoot Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP/IP, and BACnet communication. Test RS-485 communication wiring, termination, shielding, polarity, and device addressing. Configure Ethernet switches, IP addresses, gateways, and communication networks. Perform communication testing using tools such as Modbus Poll, Modscan, and vendor configuration software. Troubleshoot communication failures, intermittent data, device discovery issues, and communication timeouts. C. SCADA / Power Monitoring Integration Integrate smart components with Schneider Electric Power Monitoring Expert (PME), SCADA, and BMS platforms. Configure devices, verify parameter mapping, and validate real-time data acquisition. Test voltage, current, frequency, power, power factor, energy, THD, breaker status, and alarms. Verify device communication, trends, reports, dashboards, and event logs. Coordinate with software and design teams to resolve integration and data-mapping issues. D. Testing and Troubleshooting Perform point-to-point verification and functional testing. Troubleshoot meter communication, breaker status, trip indication, and data update issues. Verify communication between field devices, gateways, servers, and monitoring software. Support integrated system testing, customer demonstrations, and site acceptance testing. Coordinate with Schneider Electric service engineers and customer representatives. E. Documentation and Handover Prepare commissioning checklists, device lists, IP schedules, and communication test reports. Maintain punch-point lists and track issue closure. Prepare as-built documentation and commissioning reports. Provide basic operational training to customers and hand over the completed system. 3. Technical Skills Required Knowledge of LV electrical distribution systems and Main LT Panels. Experience with Schneider Electric PowerLogic meters and smart circuit breakers. Understanding of Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP/IP, RS-485, Ethernet, and BACnet. Basic knowledge of PLC, SCADA, BMS, and Power Monitoring Expert (PME). Ability to read electrical SLDs, wiring diagrams, and communication architecture drawings. Knowledge of electrical testing instruments and troubleshooting methods. Working knowledge of Windows servers, IP networking, and SQL Server is an advantage. 4. Educational Qualification Diploma or BE/B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Experience in electrical automation, smart metering, or power monitoring commissioning is preferred. 5. Key Competencies Site commissioning and troubleshooting skills. Good communication and coordination with customers and project teams. Ability to work independently at project sites. Willingness to travel as per project requirements. Strong documentation and problem-solving skills. 6. Performance Expectations Complete commissioning within the agreed project schedule. Ensure reliable communication and accurate data acquisition from all configured devices. Minimize repeat site visits through effective troubleshooting. Complete testing documentation and customer handover on time. Role & responsibilities Preferred candidate profile 0-3 Yrs Installation, Automation, Troubleshooting, PLC, PLC panel
